title: greet.sh has no --version
body:
## Problem

`greet.sh` has no way to print its own version.

## What to do

Accept `--version` (and `-V`) as the first argument. Print `greet.sh 1.0.0` and
exit 0.

`--version` must be checked before the missing-argument branch, so
`./greet.sh --version` prints the version rather than the error.

## Done when

- `./greet.sh --version` and `./greet.sh -V` both print `greet.sh 1.0.0` and exit 0.
- `./test.sh` still passes, with a case covering the new flag.
